records.text: LING 479 Semantics II (3) A&H/SSc/NSc Formal characterization of linguistic meaning. Emphasis on nature and purpose of formal semantics and on its relation to formal syntax. Prerequisite: LING 478 Offered: jointly with PHIL 479.
